snippet.title: Why Instagram Completely Changed Its Mind
snippet.description:
Adam Mosseri, Head of Instagram, breaks down Instagram’s move into long form, horizontal video (“features”) and TV. We ask what changed since he last told us long form wasn’t a priority, and how creators will get discovered and paid. Then we get tactical on sends per reach, carousels and underused features, before digging into AI and the future of social media.

snippet.title: Inside the Mind of YouTube's Anthony Bourdain
snippet.description:
Today on The Colin & Samir Show we sit down with Thomas Brag, co-founder of Yes Theory. For over a decade Yes Theory has told hopeful, human stories about the world, even as the internet rewards the opposite. We get into how he thinks about positivity versus virality, why he assumes no one cares about a video until he gives them a reason to, and how reframing an idea can turn something nobody watches into one of your biggest hits.

00:00 - What is Yes Theory

44:12 - The Pursuit of Real in an Absurd Internet
48:03 - Finding Stories No One Has Told Before

snippet.title: 11 Marketing Rules Every YouTuber Needs to Know
snippet.description:
Today on The Colin & Samir Show we sit down with Kate Tolo, the genius behind Bryan Johnson. Most people know Bryan from his quest to solve aging, but Kate is his co-founder, girlfriend, and the creative mind who took him from 2000 followers to over 10 million, a Netflix documentary, and a $60 million fundraising round. She walks us through her 11 rules for virality, backed up by the real emails, tweets, and thumbnails she's used to build the brand. It's a rare look at the actual playbook behind one of the internet's most viral personal brands.
